context.target_audience: Public community members, local citizens, disaster response monitoring authorities in Kabupaten Banjar
context.design_archetype: Organic & Earthy / Civic Performance Pro (Light Navy & BPBD Orange)
context.primary_goal: Provide a clean, accessible public distribution dashboard placed below 'Jenis Logistik' showing distribution activity over the last 7, 14, or 30 days via interactive chart only (with date range toggles, distribution time, location, distributed item names without quantities, and beneficiary household/person counts).

rules.anti_default: Strictly use Plus Jakarta Sans for titles/headers and Manrope for body text. JetBrains Mono for dates, units, and numeric data.

rules.contrast_compliance: All chart text and labels must maintain a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1. Tooltips must have solid white background with #CBD5E1 border, no transparent overlay.
rules.hover_contrast: Toggle buttons on hover must explicitly set both background and text colors.

layout_and_placement.placement: Directly below the 'Jenis Logistik' catalog section in PublicPage.js
layout_and_placement.container_style: rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm mt-10

header_controls.title: Dashboard Penyaluran Logistik
header_controls.subtitle: Riwayat dan lokasi penyaluran logistik terkini (7, 14, & 30 hari terakhir)

displayed_fields: Jenis Logistik Disalurkan (Item names list, NO quantities)
tooltip.rules: DO NOT aggregate or sum beneficiary counts across distinct events. Represent each actual distribution event as recorded. Do NOT show item quantities or stock numbers.

loading.ui: Animated skeleton chart frame with 'Memuat data penyaluran logistik…'

error.ui: Alert banner with message 'Gagal memuat data penyaluran' and a retry button 'Coba lagi'

empty.ui: Informational banner 'Tidak ada catatan penyaluran logistik pada rentang waktu ini.'

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Render the new Public Distribution Dashboard section on PublicPage.js directly underneath the #jenis-logistik main catalog area.
2. Use Recharts (ResponsiveContainer, BarChart or ComposedChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, CartesianGrid) for rendering the chart.
3. Ensure public API returns events containing date, location, item names array (without quantities or stock levels), recipient KK count, and recipient Jiwa count.
4. For legacy or missing recipient values, display 'Belum dicatat' in tooltip details.

5. Include 7 Hari, 14 Hari, and 30 Hari timeframe pill switches at the top right of the dashboard section, with active state using bg-brand-blue text-white and inactive bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200.
6. Ensure tooltips show: Waktu & Tanggal, Lokasi, Jenis Logistik Disalurkan (bulleted list of item names only), and Penerima (x KK / y Jiwa).
7. Never display item quantities, stock availability, or personal beneficiary names in public endpoints or public UI.
8. Apply data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, filters, state messages, and inputs as specified in data_testid_convention.
9. Ensure mobile responsiveness: x-axis labels must rotate or format concisely (e.g., '12 Mei' or '12/05') and chart height should adjust smoothly (e.g. h-72 sm:h-80).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_and_accessibility: Maintain high contrast for all text over backgrounds. Tooltips and dropdowns MUST NOT have fully transparent backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.file_type: This project uses .js files, not .tsx files. Follow standard React JSX syntax.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.animations: Use smooth micro-interactions on hover and active states without breaking layout transitions.
